plugins.name: OpenCode Go Provider
plugins.description: Re-derived v2.3.0 EasyCLI plugin for OpenCode Go: CLIProxyAPI v8 SDK, per-plan `plans:` config (e.g. go/zen with their own base URL and model prefix), multi-protocol translation (Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages, Responses), one shared key pool, config-authoritative credential reconciliation, and host-native quota cards. Runtime plugin id stays `easycliproxyapi-opencode-provider`; the library is published as `easycliproxyapi-opencode-provider` to match the deployed artifact.
plugins.author: simple-central-ai-things
